Prototype 11 encodes N2 (92% pure) primarily through EEG (67%), with EOG (26%) and EMG (6%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+2.6 dB, sensitivity=7.2) and elevated γ (+2.6 dB, sensitivity=4.0).
The δ activity is present in 28% of each epoch (transient), with moderate eye movements (SEM 34% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with N2 physiology: confirmed: σ elevated, EOG quiescent; missing: σ relevant.
